subject: Split-credit proposal for RFP cohort and match-back terms
messages:
From: Elliot Barnes <elliot@dataspring.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@healthsync.com>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood credits for HealthSync RFP cohort

Hi Sofia,

Thanks for the quick demo last week — the team at HealthSync is excited to include Redwood in this next-stage bake-off. Procurement asked whether Redwood can split a pool of evaluation credits across four teams (two pilot teams + two parallel benchmarks) and whether those credits can be matched back to actual committed spend post-selection.

High-level asks:
- 250k token-equivalent sandbox credits split 40/30/20/10 across the cohort
- 60-day extension on trial window from activation
- Conditional match-back: if HealthSync signs a 12-month Dedicated contract, Redwood credits applied during eval roll into a 3-month production credit at a 50% match rate

Procurement is also requesting an internal schedule that maps credits to team IDs and a short statement we can share with their legal team about the conditional match-back. Can you confirm feasibility and any commercial restrictions?

Thanks,
Elliot
Elliot Barnes
Head of Integrations, Dataspring (Partner for HealthSync)
elliot@dataspring.ai

--
Note: HealthSync procurement: J. Morales, M. Patel.

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Elliot Barnes <elliot@dataspring.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood credits for HealthSync RFP cohort

Elliot — thanks for the clear ask and for looping us in. Short answer: yes, we can structure a split pool and a conditional match-back, but we need to align on a couple of guardrails so this doesn't create accounting or abuse vectors.

High-level constraints I want you and procurement to be aware of:
- Credits are allocated to an account namespace; we can assign sub-allocations to the four team IDs you provide, but ingestion/usage must be visible from HealthSync's master account for audit.
- Match-back policy: we support a single retrospective credit adjustment tied to a signed contract within 90 days of the trial end date. The match rate and duration are negotiable, but for larger pilots we typically do 50% match into one production month unless a committed spend tier is hit.
- Trial window extension to 60 days is fine; any extension beyond that requires CSM review.

Next steps I propose:
1) Ben: can you draft a short credit-allocation schedule that maps the 250k tokens as Elliot requested?
2) Marissa: can Legal/RevOps confirm we can do a 50% match-back with a 90-day sign window and produce a one-paragraph boilerplate for procurement?
3) Elliot/Joe at HealthSync: send the four team IDs and the preferred activation date.

I can commit to a redline-ready statement once Ben and Marissa weigh in — will aim to get this over within 48 business hours.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Enterprise Account Executive — Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0172

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Elliot Barnes <elliot@dataspring.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood credits for HealthSync RFP cohort

Thanks Sofia — attached is a quick draft allocation schedule (CSV) that maps the 250k pool into the 40/30/20/10 split and includes an activation column and expiration timestamp for each sub-allocation.

Notes:
- We recommend staggering activation (teams 1 and 2 activate week 0; teams 3 and 4 can activate week 2) to avoid token bursts that would push them into higher cost-per-token ranges.
- I added a small buffer row (5%) flagged as "reserve" that can be reallocated if one team under-runs. That buffer is revocable by Redwood ops if misuse is detected.

Attachment: credit_allocation_schedule.csv (attached)

Ben Carter
Senior Sales Engineer — Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Elliot Barnes <elliot@dataspring.ai>, J. Morales <jmorales@healthsync.com>
Date: Wed, 26 May 2027 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood credits for HealthSync RFP cohort

Sofia/Ben — Legal and RevOps reviewed the proposed setup. We can approve the 50% match-back at the single-month production credit level with the following caveats:
- The signed contract must be visibly linked to the HealthSync master account and reference deal HS-2027-RFP-221.
- Match-back applies only to infra tokens consumed during the approved trial window (no retroactive match on invoices or third-party fees).
- The 90-day sign window is acceptable, but RevOps requires a redline to go to procurement stating these points and that the reserve buffer is revocable.

I've attached a redline (redline_terms_v2.pdf) with the paragraph we recommend for procurement. If procurement accepts, we can issue the allocation and set up the trial accounts.

Attachment: redline_terms_v2.pdf (attached)

Marissa Cole
Head of RevOps — Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: J. Morales <jmorales@healthsync.com>, Elliot Barnes <elliot@dataspring.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 26 May 2027 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood credits for HealthSync RFP cohort

Joe / Elliot — thanks for the fast turnaround. Per Marissa's note and Ben's schedule, Redwood will:
- Reserve a 250k token pool on HealthSync's master account and pre-create four sub-allocations as attached (CSV).
- Apply a 60-day trial window from each sub-allocation's activation date.
- If HealthSync signs the referenced Dedicated contract within 90 days of the trial window end, Redwood will apply a one-time production credit equal to 50% of the trial tokens consumed (capped at the matched month) to the production billing account.

Please confirm the four team IDs and preferred activation date. Once confirmed, we'll send a DocuSign with the redlined paragraph for signature and then push the credits live.

Next actions for HealthSync:
- Confirm team IDs + activation start (reply to this thread)
- Sign DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/sign/ABCD-HealthSync-RFP

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scheduled.

Best,
Sofia
